project_title: Multi-Sensor Flood Mapping in the Timure/Rasuwa Gorge
fusion_sources: Sentinel-1 SAR change features: VV, VH, and VV/VH ratio changes in dB (23 July to 28 August 2026)
Sentinel-2 optical change features: six band differences and dMNDWI (24 to 27 August 2026)
features: Sentinel-1: dVV_dB, dVH_dB, and dRatio_dB using July 23 pre-event bands sec5 (VV) and sec4 (VH), and August 28 post-event bands sec11 (VV) and sec10 (VH). Sentinel-2: AUG27 minus AUG24 differences for B02, B03, B04, B08, B11, and B12, plus the MNDWI difference.
validation: RepeatedStratifiedKFold with 2 folds and 10 repeats (20 splits), random_state=42, using the same splits for all models. Reported scores are mean accuracy across splits. No spatial grouping or independent external holdout was used.
key_conclusion: The MLP had the highest reported mean accuracy (0.9514) in this run, followed by SVM-RBF (0.9206) and Decision Tree (0.9186). Only accuracy was calculated in the supplied comparison; these results are exploratory and do not establish spatially independent or real-world performance.
limitations: The evaluation contains 45 labeled samples (30 background and 15 flood).
Repeated stratified random splits do not account for spatial dependence or provide an independent external validation.
Only mean accuracy is reported; F1, precision, recall, and split-level standard deviations were not calculated in this run.
No trained model artifact or validated flood-classification raster is included in this results export.
source: Supplied fused_s1_s2_dataset.csv comparison code and reported output. Served statically; the API does not retrain models on startup.
